declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section/offence carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Of 3 pending cases (143/188/341/149; 177 with RPA 1951; 147/341/353/427/149 with Police Act 32), none individually qualify. Separately, 2 FERA/FEMA Act convictions (Section 57 of FERA 1973; Sections 8(3),8(4),49,56,68(1) of FERA/FEMA) from 25 Jul 2012 are counted as serious given the substantial penalties those provisions carry; both convictions are under appeal with sentence and conviction stayed, SLP pending before the Supreme Court.
